SECTION I : LOSS OF OR DAMAGE TO THE VEHICLE INSURED

available_fields: Product Code
UN (Unique Identification Number)
Proposal and declaration date (as stated in the Schedule)
Premium (mentioned in the Schedule)
Period of Insurance
Vehicle type (motor cycle / scooter / auto cycle or any other motorised two wheeled vehicle mentioned in the Schedule)
Depreciation rates for parts replaced (rubber/nylon/plastic parts, tyres, tubes, batteries, fibre glass components, glass, wooden parts, other parts)
Age of vehicle (for depreciation calculation)
% of Depreciation (for parts replacement)
Rate of Depreciation for Painting (material cost component)
Insured's Declared Value (IDV)
Manufacturer's listed selling price of the brand and model
% of Depreciation for fixing IDV (based on vehicle age)
Market Value (for Total Loss / Constructive Total Loss claims)
Threshold for Constructive Total Loss (75% of IDV)
Limits of liability (as laid down in the Schedule)
Legal liability for death or bodily injury to any person (including occupants, except for hire or reward)
Legal liability for damage to third-party property

summary: This document is the policy wording for ICICI Lombard's Two Wheeler Vehicle Package Policy (Product Code - 3005). It outlines the terms, conditions, and coverage details for insurance against loss or damage to the insured two-wheeler vehicle and third-party liability. Key sections include coverage for loss/damage to the vehicle (with depreciation schedules for parts and painting), Insured's Declared Value (IDV) calculation, and third-party liability indemnification. The document specifies exclusions, claim processes, and conditions for repairs, along with tables for depreciation rates based on vehicle age.
